target_customer: Individual professionals and small business users who manage relationships through email
problem: People lose touch with friends, clients and colleagues; Etacts showed who they had lost touch with and reminded them to reach out.

founders.name: Evan Beard
education: Duke University, Economics and Computer Science
founders.background_notes: From his YC profile. Later CEO of Standard Bots.

founders.name: Howie Liu
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on YC page and co-founder in TechCrunch coverage; education not found.

exit.reason: Company stated it would pursue other opportunities and shut the service on 2011-01-31

competitors.name: Gist
competitors.what: Email side panel with social profiles, conversation stats and notes

competitors.name: Rapportive
competitors.what: Gmail plugin showing social profile info, no reminders

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading email headers via IMAP or OAuth and surfacing lapsed contacts; moderate integration work for two founders.

defensibility.rationale: Copyable in weeks and dependent on access to email accounts; CRM incumbents could add it.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Salesforce acquired the team in December 2010 and shut the service in January 2011.

market_need_then: Personal and sales relationship management was crowded with contact tools, indicating demand; the founders cited their own frustration keeping in touch.

branding.domain_note: etacts.com; fetch blocked with 403 so current state unknown.

identity.voice_and_tone: plain, relationship-focused copy on the YC listing

brand_strength.rationale: No sources show press on the brand, only product coverage; name has a spelling twist and the brand ended within about a year of the YC launch.

outcome_analysis: Etacts was a two person email CRM that raised roughly 700 thousand dollars in angel money in 2010 and was bought by Salesforce in December 2010, only nine months after creation according to one source. Salesforce shut the service in January 2011 without disclosing plans, so this looks like a soft landing rather than a product outcome.
notes: Seed amount 700K per TechCrunch; Dealroom says about 740K and Raising.fi 650K, CB Insights about 670K total. Investor names appear only on aggregators (SV Angel, Y Ventures, Jawed Karim, Ashton Kutcher, Steve Chen, Joshua Schachter) and are left out as unverified. Company website field is empty in the directory; etacts.com returned 403. Competitor dates come from a January 2011 comparison page, shortly after founding.
